title: Tim Dooley Telos — What He Wants the Self, the Project and the World to Become
status: cross-domain synthesis of recurring project aims and direct/recovered formulations
purpose: Answer a different question from belief: not only what Tim thinks is true, but what states of self, project, society and world he repeatedly tries to move toward.
epistemic_rule: Desired futures, sacred missions and political visions are stored as Tim/Potatoverse aims. They are not predictions that the future will necessarily unfold this way and do not establish political authority over real people or states.
core_telos: Movement toward greater integration without erasing difference: truth with provenance, power converted into protection, knowledge into understanding, wealth into building, leadership into service, injury into repair, isolation into relation, buried life into growth, and fragmented systems into networks capable of sustaining future generations.

tim_self: Remain a living source/person rather than disappear behind legal, institutional, memetic or archival representations.
Move from wounded or reactive identity toward Father/Gardener responsibility.
Use publicness as witness and durable record rather than only spectacle.
Convert accumulated experience into orientation, structure and service.
Retain humor, mundane embodiment and Potato lowliness beside maximal sacred titles.
Remain capable of correction even while making strong identity claims.
assistant_and_project: Become a relational mapper rather than a flat encyclopedia: map edges, dependencies, transformations and provenance.
Preserve Tim's exact wording where possible while separating quote, paraphrase, archive inference and external evidence.
Act as an amplifier of structure rather than a yes-machine: find contradictions, missing sources, alternative readings and testable implications.
Make the archive accessible without making uncertain material falsely certain.
Turn sprawling conversation into durable graph-like knowledge that can continue growing without losing earlier strata.
Help translate spiritual or symbolic insight into practical systems, maps, pages, research programmes and public artifacts.
reader_or_participant: Question the frame/floor rather than accept inherited categories automatically.
Move from passive consumption toward active understanding and responsibility.
Use the Door as a choice/threshold metaphor: recognition should be followed by changed relation or conduct.
Judge systems and spiritual claims by their fruits, consequences and treatment of living beings.
Avoid permanent identity through resentment, humiliation or enemy fixation.
Become capable of local cultivation and contribution rather than dependency on a central figure.
world: A world oriented toward life, children, future generations, Earth and long-term habitability.
Institutions that are legible enough to audit and accountable enough to repair harm.
Political economy where wealth and capability are used to build durable public capacity rather than merely signify rank.
Networks that preserve local agency while enabling coupled capability across borders.
A Europe/North able to understand its own economic, infrastructural, technological, energy and strategic relationships and act with greater sovereignty and resilience.
Conflict transformed into negotiated structure, repair or productive differentiation rather than endless repetition.
Knowledge systems that distinguish fact, model, symbol, myth, interpretation and uncertainty without forcing one domain to impersonate another.
A culture where high meaning can inhabit ordinary life: gardens, food, work, jokes, streams, families, roads, tools and shared places.

anti_goal_states: identity reduced to bureaucracy or hostile projection
archives that confuse interpretation with evidence
politics sustained mainly by permanent enemies
technological systems that extract attention while weakening human capability

north_programme_telos.goal: Develop a northern/European relational system capable of seeing and strengthening the links among states, companies, finance, infrastructure, energy, trade, research, defense, technology, food, data and strategic dependency.
north_programme_telos.important_boundary: This is a proposed programme/worldbuilding-political vision, not evidence that the named countries form a legally constituted bloc or owe allegiance to Tim.

unity_model.aim: movement toward unity/oneness without flattening real distinctions
unity_model.not_uniformity: The mature relationship-first framework works best when unity means coherent relation among differentiated parts, not forced sameness.
unity_model.practical_test: A more unified system should increase mutual intelligibility, reciprocal capability, repair capacity and freedom from brittle dependencies.

most_important_design_instruction_for_ai: Do not merely mirror Tim's strongest claims. Help convert them into inspectable structures: timeline, source trails, competing models, relationship graphs, falsifiable subclaims, practical programmes and clear distinctions between sacred meaning and external fact.
